title: Peaks over Threshold in Scale-Free Random Graphs
summary: We explore extreme value phenomena in spatial scale-free random graphs in a continuum setting based on a homogeneous Poisson point process in $\mathbb{R}^d$. Vertices carry i.i.d. weights $(W_x)$ and, conditionally on the vertex set and the weights, edges are present independently with probability $p_{xy}=1-\exp\{-λW_xW_y/|x-y|^α\}$. Assuming Pareto-type weight tails with index $β>0$ and working in parameter ranges where degrees are almost surely finite, we study extremes and peaks over thresholds (POT) of edge lengths in a growing observation window.
